title: Keys and Rooms
problemStatement: There are n rooms labeled from 0 to n-1. Initially, only room 0 is unlocked. Each room may contain keys to other rooms. Determine whether it is possible to visit every room.
input: Integer n A list where the i-th list contains the keys found in room i.
output: Print true if every room can be visited; otherwise print false.
constraints: 1 <= n <= 1000 Total number of keys does not exceed 3000.
